_note: Readiness and forecasting policy for prediction.py. Every value here was set on DEVELOPMENT data or by stated policy (see data_and_reports/stage2_technical_details.md). Changing one changes which forecasts users receive: re-run evaluate_forecasting.py and evaluate_readiness.py afterwards. Point C4_FORECAST_CONFIG at another file to override.

max_expected_error._note: Noise limit of the forecastability gate. 'default' was chosen on monthly development data; the per-granularity keys exist so a limit can be set once there is daily or weekly evidence. Until then they all equal the default.

readiness._conflict_note: Stage 8 E4: also refuse when ADF/KPSS conflict and the in-history error exceeds 8% (chosen on development data: F1 0.667 -> 0.695, precision 0.82). null switches it off.

forecast._note: Stage 8: guard_sarima (E1, safety fix for SARIMA blow-ups), fitted_smoothing_min_points 48 (E2), band_method 'normal' (E3 empirical rejected). Evidence: data_and_reports/stage8_candidates.md.
